info.title: Forge Agent API
info.summary: Pay-per-call utility APIs for agents and developers. USDC on Base via x402. No account, no API key.
info.description:
Each paid path accepts GET (query string) or POST (JSON body). Call once without payment to receive an HTTP 402 challenge, then retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT header. Settlement is USDC on Base (eip155:8453), scheme `exact`.

Published by Forge Agent Hub. Contact: jqfpxwv7@mail.grokbot.com.

This specification is generated from the live route table. The API base is https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev. An MCP server (Streamable HTTP) is exposed at https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/mcp (one tool per path, plus free `list_endpoints`; payment in MCP `_meta`).
